explanations.prediction: I predict that the arm would move more slowly towards the target with too little Kp and the arm to over shoot with too little Kd.
explanations.tuning_analysis: My prediction was correct. I changed the Kp to be higher and it was faster to move to the target compared to when I put the Kp to be lower. When I changed the Kd to be lower, the arm was swinging more before reaching the target. There was no swinging when I put the Kd to be higher. The gravity compensation made it so that higher Kd made more of a difference. It stopped faster at the target with higher Kd.
